meta.name: fictiv
meta.description: Operate Fictiv (app.fictiv.com), the on-demand manufacturing platform, end to end in the user's browser. Covers uploading CAD parts, configuring process, material, finish, threads, tolerances and inspections, getting instant or manual quotes, reading and fixing DFM feedback, choosing lead time and region, checking out and paying (card or PO), tracking orders, reordering, and troubleshooting. Use this skill whenever the user mentions Fictiv, wants a part CNC machined, 3D printed, sheet-metal fabricated, urethane cast, injection or compression molded, or die cast through an online service, asks to "get a quote" or "order parts" for a STEP/SLDPRT/STL file, wants to check a Fictiv quote or order status, or has a problem with a Fictiv upload, DFM warning, price or checkout. Use it even if Fictiv isn't named but the user wants custom parts manufactured and has a Fictiv account.

copy.tagline: 上传零件图纸,在线拿到加工报价、下单付款并跟踪订单进度
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有 STEP/STL 图纸,想找厂子做样件或小批量零件。
copy.tagline_en: Upload part files, get instant quotes, order and track production
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a STEP or STL file and want a shop to make prototype or small-batch parts.

howto.what: Claude 会在你的浏览器里操作 Fictiv 网站：上传 CAD 文件、选工艺和材料、读取并解释 DFM 反馈、拿到报价、下单付款，以及查询订单状态。正式下单等花钱动作前会先向你确认。
howto.when: 当你提到 Fictiv、想用在线服务加工零件（如 CNC、3D 打印、钣金等），或要为 STEP/SLDPRT/STL 文件「报价」「下单」，以及查看报价、订单状态或碰上上传、DFM、付款问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我给这个 STEP 文件报个价
say.note: 会先问齐材料、数量等需求再上传

say.text: 查一下我 Fictiv 上那个订单到哪了
say.note: 需要你的 Fictiv 账号已登录

say.text: 这个零件提示 DFM 警告，是什么意思
say.note: 会解释问题并给出处理选项

howto.what_en: Claude drives the Fictiv web app in your browser: uploading CAD files, setting process and material, reading DFM feedback, getting quotes, checking out and paying, and tracking orders. It asks for approval before anything that spends money.
howto.when_en: Use when the user mentions Fictiv, wants a part CNC machined, 3D printed or sheet-metal fabricated, asks to quote or order a STEP/SLDPRT/STL file, or hits an upload, DFM or checkout problem.

say_en.text: Quote this STEP file for me
say_en.note: Collects material, quantity and other specs first

say_en.text: What does this DFM warning mean?
say_en.note: Explains the issue and offers fix or proceed
